entries.zh: 恶性难移、积习不改：谓人趋恶成性，无法改弦更张（袂變：不能改变）
entries.en: inclined to evil and unable to turn from it; set in one's bad ways, incapable of change.

entries.zh: 断理不断亲：亲眷之间可据理争执，争端虽断而亲情不断（对事不废亲）
entries.en: (proverb) cut off in disputes yet not in kinship: one may quarrel over a matter without breaking with relatives.
entries.notes: 西语栏含[疑:wa/va]存疑片段，释义以汉字栏“断理不斷親”为主。

entries.zh: 钦服他人：倾心敬重、折服于某人
entries.en: to admire and defer to someone; honoring him with respectful submission.
the heart of man is perverse.
entries.notes: 西语栏[空]，词头缺失，仅据汉字与闽南音写释义，词条归属存疑。

entries.zh: 独自离群、不与人通；固执己见、只认自家主意
entries.en: unsociable, solitary, keeping to himself; self-opinionated, fond of his own view.

entries.zh: 昏昧糊涂、行事不加思量（朦：昏暗不明，转指懵懂欠虑）
entries.en: thoughtless, heedless; muddle-headed, dim of mind.
entries.notes: 汉字栏[疑:膫/朦]，据音写bong定为“朦”（昏昧）；缩写Inconsiderad.展开依赖推断。

entries.zh: 朦胧昏昧：懵懂无知、行事全无道理
entries.en: muddle-headed and dim; thoughtless deeds done without reason.
entries.notes: 两字均有[疑]（膫/朦、朧/龍），据音写bong long与西语义定作“朦朧”。

entries.zh: 说话反复、出尔反尔（呾来呾去：说来说去）；忽拒忽允，毫无定准
entries.en: inconstant: saying first one thing then another; now denying, now conceding; lacking all firmness.

entries.zh: 疳：疮肿溃烂之症，腺体肿胀之病（横痃一类）
entries.en: incordio: bubo, painful swelling of the glands; glossed with gan, an ulcerous sore.
entries.notes: 汉字栏仅“疳”一字，音写第二音节未定字；据同页诸incordio条系疮肿类病名推补。

entries.zh: 腺体疮肿之症（incordio）；汉字栏作“淚燭”，首字有淚/疳之疑，字面与病义不合
entries.en: incordio (bubo, glandular sore); entry characters read as 'tear-candle', first character uncertain (淚/疳), sense unresolved.
entries.notes: 汉字栏[疑:淚/疳]，“淚燭”字面与疮肿病义不协，存疑待考。

entries.zh: 腺体疮肿之症（incordio）；汉字栏作“鬧精”，首字有鬧/鬪之疑，字面义难确考
entries.en: incordio (bubo, glandular swelling); entry characters 'nao-jing' with first character uncertain (鬧/鬪), sense unresolved.
entries.notes: 汉字栏[疑:鬧/鬪]，与病名的对应关系不明。

entries.zh: 便毒：中医指腹股沟横痃肿痛之毒疮，马尼拉语境多与花柳疮毒相涉
entries.en: an inguinal bubo, toxic swelling of the groin (Chinese-medicine term 'bian-du'); incordio, glandular abscess.

entries.zh: 疳疮：下疳类疮疡溃肿之症
entries.en: gan-sore, chancre-like ulcer; incordio, a venereal/glandular sore.

entries.notes: 闽南语栏原文[残]损（仅余“畔”字与不可辨音片），西语“不可矫正”之义无从对证。

entries.zh: 骂亦不改、顽劣难驯，不可救药
entries.en: incorrigible: scolding will not reform him; past mending.
entries.notes: 汉字栏“金罵”字面与词义对应不明，释义主要依西语栏incorregible。

entries.zh: 屡打不改、打而无动于衷（不知悔惧）
entries.en: incorrigible and unheeding: beaten without feeling, without mending.
entries.notes: 汉字栏“掌皮打”字面难解，释义依西语栏'incorregible no siente'（打而不改、不知畏惧）。

entries.zh: 明知故犯、积习不改（故意为之）
entries.en: incorrigible: does it deliberately, on purpose.
entries.notes: 汉字栏“越自”字面难确考，释义依西语栏'hace lo de propósito'。

entries.zh: 无法无天、无父无君：形容悖逆成性、顽劣不可矫正
entries.en: incorrigible and lawless: without law, without king, without father — a triply 'without' formula for utter disobedience.
entries.notes: 西语栏末“I ni pe.”疑为截断（或为ni padre），闽语栏三叠“无…”与汉字“無父”相合。
